_implementation_notes: LAVENDER TOWN — Phase 2/3 transition. Maps 50, 418, 416, 419, 420.
Tone: Mournful, quiet, exhausted. Lavender is where death is real.
Contrast with rest of Kanto — no progress, no possibility, just loss.
Map 50 (Lavender Town overworld): Town NPCs, town sign, ghost girl,
darkness event NPCs (switch 701). Morty rematch (switches 918+15).
Mr. Fuji darkness event (switch 701) preserved mechanically.
Sabrina darkness event (EV046, switch 709+701) preserved mechanically.
Map 418 (Pokemon House): Mr. Fuji's orphanage. Volunteers, Pokemon,
bookshelves, Marowak picture, Cresselia quest (switches 805, 810,
var 282, switches 1029-1030). ALL mechanical events preserved.
Map 416 (Pokemon Center): Nurse Joy (mechanical — preserved),
egg seller, clown/joke-teller (mechanical — preserved),
Rocket gossip NPC.
Map 419 (House 1): Stone Maniac (mechanical — preserved),
TV events, cupboard.
Map 420 (House 2): Move tutor Ominous Wind (mechanical — preserved),
TV events, clown reference NPC, cupboard.
Pokemon Tower floors (400-403, 467-469) are SPECIAL_LOGIC — NOT
included here. They have complex ghost/Rocket event sequences.
FUJI CHOICE: insert_commands after Mr. Fuji rescue (handled in
Pokemon Tower SPECIAL_LOGIC). Sets Variable 344 (SYNTH_FUJI_CHOICE)
and Switches 1135-1138 (BAN/FREE/OVERSIGHT/UNSURE).
Those switches are referenced in Saffron (Ariana) and Cinnabar
(Blaine mansion). The choice itself is NOT in this file.
Line length limit: ~42 characters per line for RPG Maker XP text box.
